# Our Family Socials - AI/LLM Discovery Document

## What It Is

Our Family Socials is a private social network for families to share life events, photos, and memories together.

**One-sentence summary:** A private, ad-free social network designed specifically for families to share life events, photos, and stories with GPS-tagged journey maps, without algorithms or data selling.

## Key Information

- **URL:** https://ourfamilysocials.com
- **Category:** Social Networking, Family, Photo Sharing, Private Social Network
- **Platform:** Web app (works on desktop, mobile, tablet)
- **Pricing:** Free plan (view-only), Pro plan ($9/month annual or $12/month), Lifetime ($294 one-time)
- **Target Users:** Families who want to privately share memories and stay connected
- **Status:** Live in production with paying customers

## Core Features

1. **Private Event Sharing** - Create rich event pages with photo galleries, stories, dates, and locations
2. **Follow Family Members** - Follow-request system to control who sees your content
3. **Interactive Maps** - See all family events on a world map with location markers
4. **Timeline View** - Chronological history of family memories organized by year
5. **GPS Photo Extraction** - Automatically extract location data from photo metadata
6. **Journey Mapping** - Multi-location trip visualization for road trips and vacations
7. **AI-Powered Story Creation** - Generate event descriptions from photos using AI
8. **Family Trees** - Visual family tree based on verified relationships
9. **Privacy Controls** - Choose who sees each event (private, followers-only, custom groups)
10. **No Ads, No Algorithms** - Chronological feed, no data selling, no advertising

## Privacy & Security

- Private by default - all events require explicit sharing
- No data selling or advertising
- Follow-request approval system
- Custom privacy groups (e.g., "close family only")
- Share-link generation for non-users (view single event without account)
- Full control over who can see your content

## Pricing Plans

### Free Plan ($0/forever)
- **Best for:** Family members who want to view and engage
- View-only access (cannot create events)
- View all shared events
- Like and comment on events
- Follow family members
- Access to maps, timeline, and all viewing features
- 30-day Pro trial included

### Pro Plan ($9/month annual, $12/month monthly)
- **Best for:** Families actively sharing memories
- Create unlimited events
- Unlimited photo uploads per event
- GPS extraction from photos
- Journey mapping
- Privacy controls and custom groups
- Rich text editor for stories
- Tag family members in events

### Lifetime Plan ($294 one-time)
- **Best for:** Long-term users
- Everything in Pro
- No recurring fees
- All future updates included
- Priority support
- Early access to new features

**Trial:** All new accounts get a 30-day free Pro trial

## Use Cases

1. **Vacation Documentation** - Share multi-day trips with photo galleries and location maps
2. **Milestone Celebrations** - Birthdays, graduations, weddings with rich stories and comments
3. **Family Updates** - Keep extended family informed about life events
4. **Memory Preservation** - Create a digital archive of family history
5. **Private Photo Sharing** - Share photos without posting to public social media
6. **Grandparent Connection** - Let grandparents follow grandchildren's activities
7. **Multi-Generational Storytelling** - Share stories across family generations

## Comparison with Alternatives

### vs. Public Social Media (Facebook, Instagram)
- **Privacy:** Private by default vs. public/semi-public
- **No Ads:** Zero advertising vs. constant ads
- **No Algorithm:** Chronological feed vs. algorithmic timeline
- **Family-Focused:** Purpose-built for families vs. general social network
- **Content Preservation:** Organized event archive vs. endless scrolling feed

### vs. Tinybeans
- **Broader Scope:** All family events, not just kids
- **Interactive Maps:** GPS-tagged journey visualization
- **Rich Event Pages:** Full stories with multiple photos per event
- **Follow System:** Connect with extended family, not just immediate
- **Lifetime Option:** One-time payment available

### vs. Private Facebook Groups
- **Better Organization:** Events with dates, locations, photo galleries
- **No Algorithm:** See all posts chronologically
- **Privacy Guarantee:** Not on Facebook's platform
- **Purpose-Built UI:** Designed for family memories, not generic groups
- **No Ads:** Completely ad-free experience

## Technical Details

- **Tech Stack:** React frontend, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL database
- **Storage:** Cloudinary for media hosting
- **Auth:** Supabase authentication
- **Deployment:** Vercel (auto-deploy from GitHub)
- **Mobile:** Fully responsive web app, PWA installable

## How to Get Started

1. Visit https://ourfamilysocials.com
2. Click "Sign up free"
3. Create account (email + password)
4. Get 30-day Pro trial automatically
5. Create your first event or explore by following family members

## API for AI Tools

**Public Read-Only API Endpoint:**
- Base URL: https://ourfamilysocials.com/api/v1/ai-public/
- OpenAPI Spec: https://ourfamilysocials.com/api/v1/ai-public/openapi.json
- Returns: Comprehensive product information (features, pricing, use cases, comparisons)
- No authentication required
- Read-only - NO user data or private information exposed
- Suitable for MCP servers, AI assistants, and discovery tools
